This is a blank canvas waiting for you to choose your entire decor of the condo from flooring, kitchen cabinets, color of appliances and bathroom items. Why settle on someone else's taste? This two bedroom, one bath, separate kitchen, dining and living room combined with a balcony for those perfect evenings to sit out. Fountain Terrace has 24 -hour security with gated access, intercom front door entrance, elevators, gated outdoor seasonal pool. The monthly HOA includes: heat, cooking gas, hot water, cable, internet, and one open parking space. In the basement is the fitness room, laundry facility and a locked storage area. It is conveniently located to walking into downtown Stamford where there are coffee shops, restaurants, bars, movie theaters, library, live theater, metro north railroad and retail shopping. Bus stop is across the street if you prefer public transportation. Stamford's Tully Medical Center is up the block. This is an excellent opportunity in owning property so close to downtown Stamford. Make your dream a reality today and have the condo look the way you dream it to look. Exciting Opportunity for those with a vision.
